apps.localizedDescription:
AeroStore:

A community-driven alternative app store for iOS. Sideload, manage, and refresh apps on your device — no jailbreak required.

Pairing File:

On first launch, AeroStore needs a pairing file to communicate with your device for installing and refreshing apps.

Getting a pairing file:

• AltServer — Connect your device to a computer running AltServer; the pairing file is generated automatically.
• MobileDevicePairing — Use tools like idevicepair to generate one.
• iLoader — Can fetch and import a pairing file directly on-device.
• SideStore — If you already have SideStore set up, it can export its pairing file.

You can also tap Browse without pairing to explore available sources — add the pairing file later in Settings when you're ready to install or refresh.

versions.localizedDescription:
App Refresh & Install (AFC):

• Fixed: AFC directory creation failure — A path parsing bug caused the staging folder on-device to never be created correctly, causing all IPA transfers to fail.
• Improved: AFC error message — The "AFC was unable to manage files" error now includes a clear explanation and actionable steps instead of a cryptic one-liner.

• Fixed: RPPairing support — Apps can now be fully installed and refreshed using the new RPPairing format required by iOS 26 and later.

Device Discovery & VPN:

• Fixed: VPN peer IP discovery — AeroStore now reads the device IP directly from the kernel (ifa_dstaddr on the utun interface) instead of guessing via subnet math. This fixes device discovery for LocalDevVPN, IKEv2, and WireGuard on all iOS versions.
• Fixed: TunnelConfig binding — VPN configuration settings (override IP, fake IP) were being ignored and replaced with hardcoded values. Now your actual settings are used.
• Fixed: Pre-existing VPN tunnels not recognized — If LocalDevVPN was already active before AeroStore launched, it would not be detected. AeroStore now retargets the muxer address at startup to pick up already-active tunnels.
• Fixed: Default VPN IP — The default override IP is now correctly set to 10.7.0.1 for all iOS versions (was incorrectly set to 192.168.1.50 on iOS 17.4+).

UDID & Signing:

• Fixed: "Could not determine device UUID" — fetchUDID() now falls back to reading the UDID from Info.plist if the minimuxer engine returns nil, preventing spurious "unknown UDID" errors during refresh.

JIT (Just-In-Time Compilation):

• New: JIT tab — JIT is now a first-class tab in the main tab bar (⚡️), no longer hidden as a button inside My Apps.
• Fixed: JIT crash on launch — Pressing the JIT button would crash the app with "Device mount check (Rust isMounted / isPairing)". This was caused by StikJIT looking for its pairing file in a different location than where AeroStore stores it. AeroStore now syncs the pairing file to StikJIT's expected path at startup.

🔧 Other Improvements:

• Fixed: Crash recovery loop on IPA install — Fixed an infinite crash loop triggered by database corruption during app installation.
• Fixed: UI rendering artifacts — Removed broken custom tab bar background code that caused black/white boxes to appear in the tab bar on certain devices.
• Version: 1.1.5.
